en.name: Whole wheat flour
en.summary: Whole wheat flour keeps 12 months in the pantry, 2 years refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 2 years in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). The difference between wholemeal and white flour is the germ: the germ's oil is what goes rancid, and cold is what slows it.
en.pantry: 12 months in an airtight container on a cool, dark, dry shelf, and go by smell rather than the date if the kitchen has been warm. Whole wheat flour keeps the bran and the germ, and the germ carries oil — that is the entire reason it does not keep like white flour, which has had the germ milled out. Heat, light and air drive the oil to oxidise, so an opaque sealed tub at the back of a cupboard genuinely does better than a paper bag next to the hob. Fresh wholemeal smells sweet and nutty; a stale bag smells sharp and faintly of oil paint.
en.fridge: 2 years at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in an airtight container, which is double what the cupboard gives. Refrigeration is not preserving the flour from microbes — flour is far too dry for that — it is slowing the oxidation of the germ oil, and it has the useful side effect of keeping pantry moths out entirely. The container matters: wholemeal flour takes up moisture and odours readily, and a cold bag opened in a warm kitchen condenses water into the flour. Let it warm to room temperature before you bake.
en.freezer: 2 years at −18 °C (0 °F), the same window as the fridge, which tells you plainly that the limiting process is chemical rather than microbial. Use an airtight tub or a double bag with the air pressed out, and label it. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe well beyond that; what runs out is flavour. Freezing a new bag hard for a couple of days also kills any weevil eggs that came home with it, which is worth doing whatever you then do with the flour.
en.thawing: Bring the sealed container up to room temperature before opening so the flour does not take up condensation, and let the flour itself warm before mixing — cold flour and cold water make a stiff dough that resists shaping.
spoilage: A sharp, paint-like or crayon smell — rancid germ oil, the usual end.
A bitter aftertaste in bread made to a recipe that used to work.
Webbing, tiny moths or larvae in the container, in which case the lot goes out.
Hard clumps or a caked surface, meaning moisture reached the flour.
tips: Decant into an opaque airtight tub; the paper bag protects nothing.
Refrigerate or freeze if you bake wholemeal only occasionally.
Freeze a new bag hard for a couple of days to kill weevil eggs.
Let flour come to room temperature before mixing a dough.

faq.q: How long does whole wheat flour last?
faq.a: 12 months in an airtight container in the pantry, or 2 years refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below or frozen at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Why does whole wheat flour go off faster than white flour?
faq.a: Because it still contains the germ, and the germ's oil goes rancid. White flour has had the germ milled out, so there is far less oil to spoil.

faq.q: Should whole wheat flour be refrigerated?
faq.a: It doubles the pantry life and keeps pantry moths out, so yes if you have the space and bake wholemeal only occasionally. Keep it airtight and let it warm before baking.

zh.name: 全麥麵粉
zh.summary: 全麥麵粉密封放常溫可放 12 個月，放 4 °C 以下冷藏是 2 年，−18 °C 冷凍也是 2 年。全麥和白麵粉的差別就在胚芽：會油耗的是胚芽的油脂，而低溫正是拖慢它的辦法。
zh.pantry: 裝密封罐、放陰涼避光乾燥的架子，12 個月；如果廚房一直很熱，請以氣味而不是日期為準。全麥麵粉保留麩皮和胚芽，而胚芽帶油——這就是它不像白麵粉那樣耐放的全部原因，白麵粉的胚芽在研磨時就被去掉了。熱、光和空氣推動油脂氧化，所以「不透光密封罐收在櫃子深處」真的比「紙袋放在爐邊」好得多。新鮮全麥粉聞起來甜而帶堅果香；走味的一袋則刺鼻、微帶油漆味。
zh.fridge: 裝密封罐放 4 °C 以下 2 年，是櫃子的兩倍。冷藏不是在防微生物——麵粉乾到微生物根本長不起來——而是在拖慢胚芽油的氧化；順帶還有一個很實用的好處：完全杜絕穀蛾。容器很重要：全麥粉很會吸濕也很會吸味，一包冰過的粉在溫暖廚房裡打開，水氣會凝進粉裡。烘焙前記得先讓它回到室溫。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 2 年，和冷藏同樣的期間；這件事本身就清楚說明，限制它的是化學變化而不是微生物。用密封罐或套兩層袋、壓出空氣，並貼標籤。只要全程沒退冰，超過這段時間仍然安全；先用完的是風味。另外，新買的整袋先冷凍凍硬兩三天，可以殺掉跟著回家的象鼻蟲卵——不管之後要怎麼放，這一步都值得做。
zh.thawing: 整罐密封著回到室溫再開蓋，粉才不會受潮；調麵團前也讓粉本身回溫——冷粉配冷水會做出一團不好整形的硬麵團。
spoilage: 聞起來刺鼻、像油漆或蠟筆味——胚芽油耗，最常見的結局。
用一向沒問題的配方做出來的麵包卻有苦的餘韻。
容器裡出現絲網、小蛾或幼蟲，整批丟掉。
結成硬塊或表面結成一層餅，表示水氣碰到粉了。
tips: 倒進不透光的密封罐；紙袋什麼也擋不住。
只是偶爾做全麥烘焙的話，請冷藏或冷凍。
新買的整袋先冷凍凍硬兩三天，殺掉象鼻蟲卵。
調麵團前先讓粉回到室溫。

faq.a: 密封放常溫 12 個月，或放 4 °C 以下冷藏、−18 °C 冷凍各 2 年。

faq.q: 全麥麵粉為什麼比白麵粉更快壞？
faq.a: 因為它還留著胚芽，而胚芽的油會油耗。白麵粉的胚芽在研磨時就被去掉了，可以壞的油少得多。
冷藏能把常溫壽命翻一倍，還能杜絕穀蛾；如果空間夠、又只是偶爾用，那就冰吧。記得密封，烘焙前先回到室溫。
